entries.title: Your MCP servers' keys are kept in Secrets
entries.body: When an MCP server's Runs line sets a key, such as NOTES_KEY=..., Infinitary now keeps the key in Secrets, sealed with your system's secret store, and the line keeps only a reference to it. Putting the key on the line is your consent, so the server gets it each time it starts, without a question, and a PATH setting stays on the line as you wrote it. Keys on servers you already added move into Secrets on their own, and removing a server forgets its keys.

picture.alt: Settings, Secrets, holding one MCP server's key, open: Infinitary keeps it for a server added in Integrations and gives it to the server each time it starts, without asking, with Manage in Integrations.
